    reservoir = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # Water source: reservoir well A1
    water_source = reservoir["A1"]

    # Transfer parameters
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    transfer_volume_ul = 100  # µL per well (one column per destination well)

    # Standard 96-well layout: rows A-H, columns 1-12

    # Enumerate every well name in row-major order (A1, A2, ..., H12)
    well_names = [f"{r}{c}" for r in rows for c in columns]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Iterate over all 96 destination wells.
    # A fresh tip is picked up for each transfer so the reservoir is
    # never cross-contaminated by a tip that has touched a plate well.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    for well in well_names:
        # Use the matching tip position on the 96-tip rack
        tip_spot = tip_rack[well]

        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_spot)
        await lh.aspirate(water_source, vols=[transfer_volume_ul])
        await lh.dispense(dest_plate[well], vols=[transfer_volume_ul])
        await lh.drop_tips()
